notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.49 automatically rebuilds stale CBT upload batches instead of blocking scores when signed test details change. Missing arms use the class-level register; unmarked scripts no longer block other completed scores. Existing online marks, original answers, local marks and earlier upload receipts are preserved. Reports show actual queued counts and clearer retry status; green still requires verified online scores. Back up and close Dynamax before updating both CBT servers between examinations. Push affected tests again; do not delete, recreate or re-pull them.
